notes.title: [Update 1.8] New island in Summer Funland
notes.content:
[url=https://ibb.co/TK83NcT][img]https://i.ibb.co/DGC2j4b/sport-island-cover.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2][b]Dear VR fans, it’s time for some exercises[/b][/h2]

It was quiet about Monad Rock lately, but we are coming back. After a while, under the radar, we have something for you! Our team happily presents a new update called "Sports Island". The primary focus in this version is the delivery of three unique attractions. For sure, they will help stretch your hands a bit. To be more precise, we introduce:

🏀 Basketball
⚾ Baseball
🏓 Table Tennis

Like all our previous DLC's this one is also for free if you have the base version of Summer Funland. Our outstanding community gave us a lot of positive vibes, and we want to pay back in return by supporting the title so long. I hope that you are still with us, and you enjoy our new content.

[h3][b]Blunt Force[/b][/h3]
There is also another big thing happening right now. Monad Rock develops a second, even more extensive project. It is called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/816070/Blunt_Force/]Blunt Force[/url], and during upcoming months we will have a big announcement about it. We want to invite you to check the title, add it to the wishlist if you will like trailer/screenshots, and check our social media channels to be up to date.

If you genuinely like our approach, please also share information about our game with your friends to promote our project across the entire VR community. 

We hope that this weekend would be great for you. Enjoy the new content and let us know what your thoughts are!
[i]Monad Rock Team[/i]

notes.title: [Update 1.7] Slice it, make it better!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32032306/40d4282a2b679d319eaebe2fb52980b589f5f047.png[/img]

[h1]Sharpen your knives, it's Hot Pot![/h1]

Monad Rock proudly presents a new update! Version 1.7 becomes available, and we are here again to provide you with plenty of fun. Our latest DLC brings to live new attraction - Hot Pot. With the update, we brought you a variety of tweaks and improvements to make Summer Funland even better place to spend your time. Have fun!

[b]Accessibility[/b]
Our game becomes more and more friendly to the majority of players. We heard your feedback about motion sickness, and with specialists of VR, we developed new systems and mechanics to reduce the body stress during the game. Hope that you will like it, although some of the attractions might be not such intensive as before (e.g., Rollercoaster).

[b]Technicalities[/b]
Feedback about different issues with platforms like WMR (controllers) or VIVE Pro (audio) comes to our ears. Our team made some improvements and people which reported problems should now truly enjoy the game without glitches etc. Another layer of that is that we made some tweaks improving the optimization of Summer Funland.

[i]Have fun and share information about Summer Funland with your friends.
Monad Rock Team[/i]

Twitter: www.twitter.com/SummerFunland
YouTube: www.youtube.com/MonadRock

notes.title: [Update 1.6] Carousel in the town
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/IncUY2q.png[/img]

[h1]Spin round and round, carousel is in the town[/h1]

New delivery - update 1.6 is live! We announced last time that we want to keep the speed and deliver every month new attraction to you - our beloved community. And we keep our promises! Check the patch notes what happened meanwhile inside Summer Funland.

[h1]UPDATE 1.6.0[/h1]
[olist][*]New attraction:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/y7S9vu2.png[/img]
[b]Carousel[/b]
It's one of the "must have" attractions in every theme park. You jump on the mount and fun begins. During the ride, some weather anomaly strikes the place. But no worries! You have your faithful wand with you. Destroy all the tornados around by using magic and finish the game as fast as you can!

[*][b]Teleportation system[/b]
Don't be afraid - we don't switch off any teleportation mode, etc. Just made some improvements with the tracking spawning points. So when you launch the game, you should be able to use teleportation more comfortably!

[*][b]User experience[/b]
Motion sickness is one of the most significant problems in VR. We know about it and still, fight with that problem. After some focus tests, we decided to optimize some attractions to make them more approachable. You should feel some improvements, especially on the craziest attractions like Rollercoaster.

[*][b]Optimization[/b]
Our dev team is also putting big attention on technical aspects. We are simplifying some processes and improving the rendering, of course keeping the graphics on a still high level!

[*][b]Bug fixing[/b]
We appreciate your constant feedback and all the information that is coming from your side. Thanks to that we are aware of new issues like for example complications with new VIVE Pro headset. Our team listens to them all the time, and this update contains further improvements which should fix your problems!

[i]Have fun and stay tuned! Next free update is planned for September.
Monad Rock Team[/i][/olist]
[h1]Social media channels[/h1]
Facebook: www.facebook.com/SummerFunland
Twitter: www.twitter.com/SummerFunland
YouTube: www.youtube.com/MonadRock

notes.title: [Update 1.5] Maze Manor, Achivements, Cards...
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/NvChuGX.png[/img]

[h1]Praise the weekend - new, free attraction arrived on servers[/h1]

High summer, right? Is hot weather annoying you? Do you prefer the air-conditioned room? We have something to make your free time more enjoyable. As we promised, just a few minutes ago, Summer Funland received new free content!

[h1]UPDATE 1.5.0[/h1]
[olist][*]New attraction:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/aV6oPJX.gif[/img]
[b]Maze Manor[/b]
Visit a new garden in our theme park. You will find logic challenges which require some manual skills! Check all, 14 machines, unlock the next paths and beat the traps set by our impish designers. You will see and understand...

https://youtu.be/Uo-Mbx70xyQ
[*][b]Achivements[/b]
Healthy competition is always good. That's why we decided to implement achievements. You can finally prove that you have beaten all the challenges and you know our virtual amusement park as own pocket!

[*][b]Trading cards[/b]
Do you want to look good on Steam? Do you want to have unique backgrounds, emojis or new badge on your profile? Summer Funland finally gives you this opportunity! Gather cards, complete the sets and delight the graphics prepared by our incredible art team.

[*][b]Optimalization[/b]
As we work on PS VR version, we did also some improvements on PC's. With the new update, you should be able to run our application on GeForce GTX 960.

[*][b]Bug fixing[/b]
Our QA ninjas are tireless. Furthermore, you guys give us great feedback which things we should improve, rework or fix. Patch 1.5.0 resolves plenty of technical issues. If you had a problem before - now it should be gone. If you still encounter some issues - feel free to write on contact@monadrock.com! We will be glad to help you.

[*][b]Windows Mixed Reality - Control settings[/b]
As some of the players reported, there is an issue with movement at WMR. That's why we decided to implement this board with information on how to navigate with Windows headsets. Hope that will help you.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/n15Hw2E.png[/img]

[i]Have fun and stay tuned! Next free update is planned for August (~before Gamescom).
Monad Rock Team[/i][/olist]
[h1]Social media channels[/h1]
Facebook: www.facebook.com/SummerFunland
Twitter: www.twitter.com/SummerFunland
YouTube: www.youtube.com/MonadRock

notes.title: New, free DLC and special CONTEST!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/AGnid7A.png[/img]

[h1]Wonderful news from Monad Rock[/h1]

Summer is coming... And we are back with a hot update! New version - 1.4.0 just appeared on the server and includes significant changes. Check what we got for you. But before that...

[h1][b][SPECIAL CONTEST][/b] Become a co-creator of the Summer Funland[/h1]
We all love achievements and badges. Soon this feature will appear in Summer Funland. Monad Rock has a unique offer for you. Visit tomorrow (June 21st, 2018) our [url=www.facebook.com/SummerFunland]facebook fanpage[/url] and take part in the competition! To not forget, you can hit the "like" button today! In our contest, you can win a unique prize for you and your friend! More details in the upcoming announcement. We are sure about one thing, you can't miss this exclusive opportunity!

[h1]UPDATE 1.4.0[/h1]
[olist][*][b]3D Breakout in Summer Funland?[/b]
We have a new, completely free update for you! Owners can download DLC named [u]Tube Ball[/u]. So, what it's all about? Check this gif!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/X29wDGa.gif[/img]

Jump back into 80's and test our retro style game. You get two rackets, one ball and entire space is yours. Crush the blocks, take advantage of power-ups and improve your personal best!

If you prefer YouTube here is the gameplay teaser: https://youtu.be/Ka2ZhK_KBoY
[*][b]Smooth experiance[/b]
We made few significant tweaks in performance optimization. The game will be more comfortable and stable on PC's.

[*][b]Free your eyes[/b]
Above that, our technical team implemented a new way of movement. It's not depending on your head direction anymore. You can move by pointing spot by the controller. Enjoy the views during a virtual wander across the Summer Funland.

[i]Have fun and stay tuned! More, (also) free updates soon!
Monad Rock Team[/i][/olist]

Twitter: www.twitter.com/SummerFunland

notes.title: 1.3.2 update is out now: a new attraction, WMR support, free locomotion, graphics settings, Russian & Chinese languages and much, much more!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hey everyone![/b][/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gotOCLC.jpg[/img]

To meet your expectations, we have prepared the first major update   for  [b]Summer Funland[/b], ripe with fixes and great new features!

The biggest one is a [b]new attraction called Ballooning![/b] It's available on the map under the gift icon. We hope you'll like it!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SFRMtnP.gif[/img]

Penguins in the [b]Whack a Penguin[/b] minigame are no longer defenseless – watch out for [b]bombs![/b] Hit one and you'll lose one of your lives!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/pOdw35e.gif[/img]

[h1] [b] We've added an Options menu where you can set the following: [/b]
 [/h1]

[h1]Resolution Scale[/h1] (pixel density, works like Super Sampling)
[list]
  [*]          	From [b]50%[/b] to [b]200%[/b]
[/list]
[h1]Graphics Quality[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Medium[/b] – detail level before the update (for GTX 970 and similar - with resolution scale -  140%)
[*][b]High[/b] – additional effects for more powerful PCs (GTX 1070 and similar – with resolution scale -  140%)
[/list] 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TcyVzOr.gif[/img]

[h1]Movement modes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Sitting teleports[/b] – for the sitting mode: you can choose the direction in which you'll turn after teleporting by tilting your controller or a thumbstick (it's represented by an arrow). We've also improved controller's sensitivity while turning.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xWASPqr.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Standing teleports[/b] – for the standing / room mode: the direction in which you'll turn after you teleport depends on where you are looking right now.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/V5x0E3J.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Free locomotion[/b] - use the thumbstick or the touchpad to move smoothly in the direction you are looking right now. Press the thumbstick to start running.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/iRqpYgz.gif[/img]

[/list]
[h1]Additional fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Windows Mixed Reality support
[*] Added Russian & Chinese languages
[*] You can now grab balloons with strings
[*] Added a tutorial for the Lighthouse Climbing Challenge
[*] You can now eat popcorn
[*] Anti-cheat fix in Jungball  Lava
[*] When you receive a star for completing an attraction, you can see your in-game progress
[/list]
[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased object grabbing range
[*] Fixed target hitting in Candy For U
[*] Improved tutorial in Candy For U
[*] Balanced throwing in Jungball Lava
[*] Turned off white fade when teleporting
[*] Improved collisions with characters roaming the park
[*] Improved rotation sensitivity when teleporting
[*] Fixed the size of the lance's band in Rainbow Space Horse
[*] Fixed texture streaming 
[*] Added more gum colors in the gum vending machine
[*] Fixed grasp during climbing in the Lighthouse Climbing Challenge
[*] Balanced volume levels in attractions
[*] Various other bug fixes
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xdtE5V7.gif[/img]

That's all for now. Let us know what you think! More updates are on their way.

Stay tuned for more, follow us on [url=facebook.com/Monad-Rock-104307457037189/] Facebook [/url], [url=twitter.com/monadrock] Twitter [/url], [url=instagram.com/monadrock] Instagram [/url] and [url=youtube.com/channel/UCq4qLvpj-YqU_63I9ioxAmg/] YouTube [/url]  for updates!
